subject: 📝 Supervisor Decision on $milestone_name — $approval_status_display
body:
Dear $researcher_name,

Your supervisor has reviewed the following milestone / output and recorded a decision. Details below.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
REVIEW SUMMARY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Milestone:       $milestone_name
Project:         $project_title (ID $project_id)
Milestone ID:    $milestone_id
Submitted:       $submitted_on
Supervisor:      $supervisor_name
Decision:        $approval_status_display
Decision Date:   $decision_date

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Supervisor comments:
$supervisor_comments

Next steps:
$next_steps

If you have questions about the decision, please raise them with your supervisor first; escalate to the postgraduate research office only if the matter cannot be resolved between you.

Kind regards,
Postgraduate Research Office
